boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, publicly documentable stops on campus-adjacent Baltimore corridors.

cards.title: Art Museum Drive: Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, beside the Homewood campus
cards.notes: Reserve the free general-admission ticket, then use the Welcome Desk map to choose a few galleries or a current exhibition.
cards.short_summary: A free art-museum stop directly beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA is at 10 Art Museum Drive and states that general admission is always free, with a free ticket requested.
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; special exhibitions may require a separate ticket. Reserve online or at the Welcome Desk.

cards.title: Art Museum Drive: BMA Sculpture Gardens
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, beside the Homewood campus
cards.notes: Walk the outdoor artworks and Spring House during garden hours; check weather conditions before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor BMA art with a documented no-reservation visit option.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA says its Sculpture Gardens and Spring House at 10 Art Museum Drive are open 10 a.m. to dusk, weather permitting, with no reservations required.
cards.access_notes: Open 10 a.m. to dusk, weather permitting; may close during storms or extreme conditions. No reservation is required.

cards.title: Art Museum Drive: Gertrude’s Chesapeake Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, inside the BMA complex
cards.notes: Pair a meal with a museum visit and request a table facing the Sculpture Garden when reservations or walk-in seating allow.
cards.short_summary: A museum-adjacent restaurant with documented garden views.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA identifies Gertrude’s Chesapeake Kitchen at 10 Art Museum Drive and says it overlooks the Sculpture Garden.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; check the restaurant or BMA page for current seating and hours.

cards.title: Art Museum Drive: BMA Shop
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, inside the BMA
cards.notes: Browse art-inspired books, jewelry, apparel, and keepsakes after the galleries; allow time before the shop’s listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named museum shop for art books and gifts.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA describes its shop as carrying books, jewelry, apparel, and keepsakes inspired by artworks on view and in its collection.
cards.access_notes: Listed BMA Shop hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with Thursday hours until 9 p.m.

cards.title: Art Museum Drive: Joseph Education Center
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, inside the BMA
cards.notes: Add a hands-on stop to the gallery route and ask the Welcome Desk for directions to the center and its current installations.
cards.short_summary: A named BMA education space with hands-on installations.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA directs visitors to the Joseph Education Center for hands-on installations and art-inspired play.
cards.source_title: Tips for Visiting — Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Located within the BMA; museum general admission is free, while special exhibitions may be ticketed.

cards.title: North Charles Street: Wyman Park Dell
cards.subtitle: North Charles Street corridor at Art Museum Drive
cards.notes: Enter from the Charles Street and Art Museum Drive side, then use the lawn and paths as a deliberate outdoor pause between stops.
cards.short_summary: A named city park landscape at the Charles Street edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Baltimore’s Wyman Park Dell master plan identifies the park’s primary entrance at Charles Street and Art Museum Drive and describes its lower lawn.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-park setting; use normal weather and daylight judgment.

cards.title: West 29th Street: R. House
cards.subtitle: West 29th Street corridor in Remington
cards.notes: Use the food hall’s vendor mix to plan a casual meal, and confirm the current vendor lineup before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named Remington food hall on West 29th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: R. House lists its location as 301 W 29th Street, Baltimore, and publishes breakfast, lunch, and dinner service hours.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required to dine; the site lists breakfast daily and lunch/dinner service every day.

cards.title: St. Paul Street: Village Learning Place
cards.subtitle: St. Paul Street corridor in Charles Village
cards.notes: Check the program calendar, then visit during listed public hours for a reading, learning, or neighborhood-program stop.
cards.short_summary: A named community learning center on St. Paul Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Learning Place lists its location at 2521 St. Paul Street and publishes learning programs and public hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–5:30 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify program availability before visiting.

cards.title: East 32nd Street: 32nd Street Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: East 32nd Street corridor near Greenmount Avenue
cards.notes: Arrive on Saturday, walk the vendor stalls, and bring a payment method if you plan to buy food or market goods.
cards.short_summary: A named Saturday market on the 400 block of East 32nd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official contact page lists its location as 400 E 32nd Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21218.
cards.access_notes: The organization’s contact page says “See you Saturday”; verify vendor offerings and any seasonal changes before visiting.

cards.title: Vineyard Lane: The Book Thing of Baltimore
cards.subtitle: Vineyard Lane corridor, just off East 32nd Street
cards.notes: Check the monthly opening announcement, then browse the giveaway shelves and take only books you can use or share.
cards.short_summary: A named free-book giveaway location near the East 32nd Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Book Thing lists 3001 Vineyard Lane and states that all books visitors take are absolutely free.
cards.source_title: The Book Thing of Baltimore Contact
cards.access_notes: Open to the public one day per month; the organization says its giveaway usually falls on the second full weekend, so confirm the current announcement.
